prompt: Challenge C115-CH1: Our anti-cheat system flags about 900 accounts a day but our manual review team can only process 200 — legitimate players are getting banned

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Anomaly detection in player behaviour telemetry uses semi-supervised learning and sequence modelling to distinguish between legitimate and malicious actions in high-frequency event streams.","sources":[{"id":"R0856","field":"bio","quote":"semi-supervised detection of anomalous player behaviour in online game telemetry"},{"id":"R0856","field":"bio","quote":"real-time anomaly detection in high-frequency behavioural telemetry streams, with particular emphasis on player action sequence modelling"},{"id":"R0856","field":"bio","quote":"cheat and bot detection, and session-level behavioural fingerprinting"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"One-class classification methods trained exclusively on legitimate player sessions achieve an F1 score of 0.81 with a false-positive rate of 4.3% when detecting scripted clients.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06623","field":"abstract","quote":"Training used only the majority legitimate-player class"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-06623","field":"abstract","quote":"The resulting model achieved an F1 score of 0.81 on the contaminated test split, with a false-positive rate of 4.3%"}]}]}
